# Blou

> Blou is a quit smoking app for iPhone that shows proof your body is healing: a photo timeline, lung (breath) checks, SOS craving help, personal insights, and every milestone on one visual timeline. It is a subscription app with a free trial; the app's features require an active subscription. It supports quitting cigarettes and nicotine pouches (such as Zyn). iPhone only (iOS 17+); there is no Android version.

The website tryblou.com is free to use. It publishes plain-language quit-smoking guides, checked against public guidance from the NHS, CDC, US Surgeon General, and WHO. It does not replace medical advice.
